title: Remarks at Salisbury, North Carolina
paragraphs: As it is growing late I will not attempt to say more than just a word to assure you how much I have enjoyed the hospitality with which I have been received in South Carolina, and this evening since entering the borders of North Carolina. It was my good fortune to meet your Governor yesterday; and to review a procession in which your state troops took part, and it was a pleasure as an American to meet my fellow-Americans in that fashion at the Exposition in the old historic southern city. I thank you heartily. I am glad to see you here and I wish you good luck and good night. (Applause)
